value.rationale: The generalized von Mises/two-harmonic exponential is a motivated natural family. This gives a complete exact admissible cone uniform over harmonic pairs and all real parameters, sharp gcd strictness, infinitely many spectral obstructions in every forbidden regime, and a finite-grid masking example. The full classification and global-vs-finite distinction are substantive structural facts beyond a routine numeric sign check.
